metadata.description: EPA 1993 county radon zone map, keyed by 5-digit county FIPS code (state+county).

zones.1: Highest potential (predicted average indoor radon screening level > 4 pCi/L)

metadata.sourcingStatus: NOT YET POPULATED. This file intentionally ships with an empty fipsZoneMapping — EPA's public county radon zone table (https://www.epa.gov/radon/find-information-about-local-radon-zones-and-radon-programs) covers ~3,100 counties and was not transcribed here to avoid shipping fabricated or mis-transcribed safety data. Populate fipsZoneMapping from that official EPA source before relying on this section in production; until then, radonZone.service.ts returns { status: 'unavailable' } for every county, which is the intended safe default.
